name: What considerations are there for flooring options in a laundry room?

mainEntity.name: What considerations are there for flooring options in a laundry room?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing flooring for a laundry room, durability and water resistance are primary considerations to withstand potential leaks or spills. Popular and practical options include ceramic tile, porcelain tile, luxury vinyl plank (LVP), and sheet vinyl. These materials are resilient, easy to clean, and offer good protection against moisture damage. Hardwood or carpet are generally not recommended due to their susceptibility to water damage and humidity. We can discuss suitable options during your design consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable and water-resistant flooring like ceramic tile, porcelain tile, or luxury vinyl plank are best for laundry rooms to withstand leaks and spills.
